changesApplied.changeMade: Changed Pydantic field from Field(None, description=...) to Field(default=None, description=...)
changesApplied.reason: Enforce schema tolerance - Pydantic validates before default-filling logic runs. Field(None, ...) makes field required at validation time, Field(default=None) makes it truly optional. This allows clients to send minimal execution data (activity_id, duration_ms, success) without validation errors.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Minimal blast radius - only affects Pydantic validation layer. Default-filling logic at lines 165-196 unchanged. No breaking changes for existing clients that send all fields. Enables new clients to send partial data as intended by specification.

changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Minimal - affects validation only. Calculation logic preserved.
